code = '''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == 1]
    points.sort()
    if len(points) < 2:
        return out
    dr = points[-1][0] - points[-2][0]
    dc = points[-1][1] - points[-2][1]
    r, c = points[-1]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    while 0 <= r + dr < h and 0 <= c + dc < w:
        r, c = r + dr, c + dc
        if out[r][c] == 0:
            out[r][c] = 2
    return out
'''
ns={}; exec(code,ns)
demo_in=[[0]*15 for _ in range(15)]
for r,c in [(1,1),(3,3),(5,5)]: demo_in[r][c]=1
demo_expected=[row[:] for row in demo_in]
for r,c in [(7,7),(9,9),(11,11),(13,13)]: demo_expected[r][c]=2
print(ns['transform'](demo_in)==demo_expected)
test=[[0]*15 for _ in range(15)]
for r,c in [(0,0),(3,3),(6,6)]: test[r][c]=1
pred=ns['transform'](test)
print([(r,c,v) for r,row in enumerate(pred) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v])
